soldier: Head yellowish brown; labrum, antennae and pronotum yellow; mandibles jet black, brown at the base. Head rectangular, the dorsal margin slightly convex. Outer margin of the mandibles square, the apex curved inwards; left mandible with three teeth, the anterior two sharp, the third broad, its tip divided into two lobes, a small tooth-like process between the bases of the second and third teeth; right mandible with two teeth, stout, triangular. Labrum extremely short, anterior margin square, twice as wide as long. Antennae with 15 segments, the basal segment columnar, narrower in the middle, segment 2 equal in length to segment 4, segment 3 obconical, markedly thickened towards the apex; eye vestige distinct. Pronotum quadrilateral, wider than the head, anterior margin strongly concave backwards, posterior margin nearly straight and slightly concave in the middle, lateral margins arcuate, posterolateral corners broadly rounded, anterolateral corners square. Tibia with three apical teeth, two of them directed downwards and one outwards. The original work recorded two soldier forms, major and minor, differing very little in morphology.
taxonomy_note: The original work placed this species in the genus Kalotermes under the name Kalotermes inamurae; it is now assigned to the genus Incisitermes.
